claims.evidence: No import documents or VIN plate visible in the photo.
No brand name, model plate, or logo is readable in the image.
Customs paperwork not shown in any photo.
Wheels are detached and lying separately; tread/condition not clearly visible.
Unit is partially disassembled with loose parts scattered; cannot tell if disassembly is for transport or due to repair/tampering.
No purchase receipt, registration date, or usage log visible.
Drivetrain and brake components not shown functioning or in close-up detail.
Lighting and distance in the photo do not allow confirmation of frame/metal surface condition.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete parts after disassembly (bodywork, wiring, brackets)
risks.proof: Full inventory photo of all removed parts laid out and matched against a parts list, or a video of reassembly.

risks.risk: Engine and drivetrain functional condition unknown
risks.proof: Video of engine starting and running, plus a test ride or load test clip.

risks.risk: Reason for disassembly (accident damage vs. routine transport) not shown
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame, forks, and body panels for cracks, bends, or repaint overspray.
Clear photo of odometer reading and any maintenance/service book.

risks.risk: Tyre and brake condition cannot be confirmed from loose wheel shots
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tyre tread (DOT/manufacture date) and brake pad/disc condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn tyres/brakes needing replacement

risks.risk: Rust or frame corrosion hidden by lighting/angle
risks.proof: Daylight close-up photos of frame joints, undercarriage, and exposed metal.

risks.risk: Registration, ownership, and customs documents not verified
risks.proof: Clear photo of vehicle registration, customs duty receipt, and ownership transfer paper.
Clear photo of VIN plate, frame number, or brand badge/logo.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of VIN/frame number and any brand badge or logo
Video of engine starting, idling, and running through gears
Clear daylight photos of frame, undercarriage, and all panel joints for rust or damage
Close-up photos of tyre tread and DOT date codes on all three wheels
Photo of registration papers, customs duty receipt, and proof of purchase
Full layout photo of all disassembled parts for completeness check
Close-up of brake pads/discs and a brake function test clip
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a partially disassembled three-wheeled trike, so it can be priced at worst case, but seller claims about brand, condition, tyres, and documentation are unverified or unverifiable remotely and should not raise the price until proven.
